name: Data Is Plural (structured archive)
description: A weekly newsletter of five useful or curious datasets, running since October 2015, with an archive of well over 1,750 entries published as a Google Sheet with one row per dataset - edition, headline, prose description and links. The single richest lead list of unusual open data in existence, and machine-readable, which makes it the natural thing to harvest.

license.name: archive released for reuse; the newsletter text is the author's
license.redistribution: link and quote with attribution; do not republish the prose wholesale

access.etiquette: it is one person's newsletter - subscribe, and credit it when a lead comes from here

probes.description: The whole archive as CSV, via the sheet's export endpoint

recipes.title: Mine the archive for a topic
recipes.code:
curl -sL 'https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1wZhPLMCHKJvwOkP4juclhjFgqIY8fQFMemwKL2c64vk/export?format=csv&gid=0' -o dip.csv
python3 -c "import csv;[print(r['edition'], r['headline']) for r in csv.DictReader(open('dip.csv')) if 'tide' in (r['text']+r['headline']).lower()]"

gotchas.trap: The export URL 307-redirects before it serves the CSV.
gotchas.fix: Follow redirects (curl -L). A client that does not will see an empty body and a 307.

gotchas.trap: Entries go back to 2015 and nobody re-checks the links, so a large share of the URLs are now dead.
gotchas.fix: Treat it as a lead list, not a catalogue - which is exactly the division of labour between it and this repository.
